ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: garden shrine
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: Plant pots in a ring round bare ground in the middle, where a tree can be planted, with a torch at the back. The roof is left off.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A green place to pray, open to the sky.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.godPurpose: A green place for {GOD}, as the colony's people picture {GOD}: roots, leaves and open sky, with a tree at its heart.

tips.li: Plant a tree in the bare ground in the middle: an oak or another long-lived tree grows into the room's heart.
A sculpture the colony makes can stand among the pots and be dedicated to the god.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: stone shrine with braziers
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A small stone-floored room with a brazier on either side of the back wall, and Dragons Descent's great dragon statue between them where the colony can make one.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A warm, close stone room to pray in.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.godPurpose: A stone room for {GOD}, as the colony's people picture {GOD}: fire in the deep rock, and the heat of it on the face.

tips.li: Planned against a rock face or dug into a hillside, it looks the way his people tell it: a room in the rock.
The braziers want wood. A statue or sculpture between them can be dedicated to the god.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: megalith enclosure
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A low-walled enclosure open to the sky, with Alpha Memes' or Vanilla Expanded's megalith standing in the middle where the colony can raise one, and a torch at each back corner. The grass inside is left to grow.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A quiet open place with a standing stone.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.godPurpose: An open place for {GOD}, as the colony's people picture {GOD}: a great stone in the grass, and the herd grazing round it.

tips.li: Leave the grass inside uncut: those who hold to Bellwether keep a strip of grass for the herd.
Without the megalith, a sculpture in the middle can be dedicated to the god instead.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: mushroom cellar shrine
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A small dark room with plant pots along the walls for mushrooms, and no lamp.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A dark, damp room where mushrooms grow.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.godPurpose: A dark room for {GOD}, as the colony's people picture {GOD}: rot, soil and the things that grow in the dark.

tips.li: Glowstool and agarilux grow in the dark: plant them in the pots and keep the light out.
Underground or in a hillside, it stays dark and cool.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: obelisk court
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A small court open to the sky, with an obelisk in the middle where the colony can make one (Alpha Memes' or Vanilla Expanded's) and a column at each corner.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: An open court to watch the sky from.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.godPurpose: An open court for {GOD}, as the colony's people picture {GOD}: wind, storm and the stars, with nothing between them and the sky.

tips.li: A telescope nearby suits those who hold to Cirrus, who watch the sky at night.
Without the obelisk, a sculpture in the middle can be dedicated to the god instead.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: white stone shrine
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A small room floored in white stone, with Alpha Memes' urns in the back corners where the colony can make them and one lamp between them.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A quiet, cold, plain room to sit in silence.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.godPurpose: A white room for {GOD}, as the colony's people picture {GOD}: snow, stillness and the long cold, and no word spoken.

tips.li: Marble or limestone keeps it white. Those who hold to Hush like it kept cool.
A sculpture between the urns can be dedicated to the god.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: sun court
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A court open to the sky with four columns and two braziers, and room in the middle for a grand statue (Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Art's, made at the sculptor's table) or another sculpture.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A bright open court to stand in the sun.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.godPurpose: An open court for {GOD}, as the colony's people picture {GOD}: noon light, warmth and the harvest ripening.

tips.li: Leave the middle clear: a grand statue or a sculpture set there can be dedicated to the god.
Those who hold to Helios like it in full sun at noon.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: moon garden
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A garden open to the sky with plant pots at the corners and Alpha Props' obelisk fountain in the middle where the colony can build one.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A quiet garden to sit in at night.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.godPurpose: A night garden for {GOD}, as the colony's people picture {GOD}: moonlight on water, sleep and dreams, and the sick getting well.

tips.li: White flowers in the pots suit it. Those who hold to Selene come here after dark.
Without the fountain, a sculpture in the middle can be dedicated to the god instead.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: tomb shrine
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A stone room with a sarcophagus at the back, Alpha Memes' Kemetic slab before it where the colony can lay one, and a brazier in each back corner.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A place for the colony's honoured dead.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.godPurpose: A tomb for {GOD}, as the colony's people picture {GOD}: the dead wrapped and kept, the hearth, and a cat watching from the dark.

tips.li: The sarcophagus is a grave: someone the colony honoured can be laid in it.
A sculpture beside it can be dedicated to the god.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: well-house shrine
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A small walled yard open to the sky, with Dubs Bad Hygiene's primitive well in the middle where the colony can dig one, plant pots at the back and a torch by the door.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A place by the water to sit and listen.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.godPurpose: A well-house for {GOD}, as the colony's people picture {GOD}: deep water, rain and the croak from the marsh.

tips.li: A well needs water under the ground: plan it near the water or the marsh.
Those who hold to Murmur sing at the well in a dry spell.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: machine shrine
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A small room with metal floors and two lamps, and room at the back for an old terminal (Ideology's worshipful terminal, where the colony has one to set there) or a sculpture.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A tidy room for machines and the people who mend them.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.godPurpose: A shrine for {GOD}, as the colony's people picture {GOD}: a small spark in every machine, and good work done by hand.

tips.li: Ideology's ancient terminal can be dedicated to the god. Any sculpture the colony makes can too.
Those who hold to Pip keep a broken thing to mend there.
